# CiteReady

> Paste a URL. Get the files AI search can actually quote. CiteReady is an implementation pack, not a tracker.

CiteReady fetches one public page and returns a zip a developer can paste the same afternoon. It does not rank you in ChatGPT. Google has said no AI system uses llms.txt directly. Checkout today is the $19 one-shot only.

## Product
- [Home](/): Paste a public URL and download the implementation pack
- [llms.txt generator](/llms-txt-generator): Spec-compliant llms.txt from a public URL
- [FAQ schema generator](/faq-schema-generator): FAQPage JSON-LD that matches visible content
- [Sample pack](/sample/citeready-sample.zip): Example artifacts generated from the homepage

## Pricing
- [Pricing](/#pricing): One-shot audit $19; upcoming Starter $29/mo, Agency $79/mo, Studio $149/mo

## Optional
- [Privacy](/#privacy): Public pages only; HTML is deleted within 24 hours
- [FAQ](/#faq): Honest limits, including that no tool can promise a ChatGPT citation
